questions.history: Clone the three-point list and enumerate in forward order.

questions.history: Clone a list containing two distinct Coordinate objects with equal XY values, preserving repetitions. Write x=9 to the first coordinate of the clone.
questions.prediction: On the merge the clone still has two positions. Only its first x changes. Both original points and the second cloned point keep their prior x.
